annotations.title: Read new events of a Berrys agent run

description: Return only what changed in a run since afterSeq: compact events, a status line, pending approvals, the final response once it ends, nextAfterSeq, and retry_after_seconds (wait that long before polling again; null once the run has ended). Give runId, or conversationId for the latest run in that conversation (e.g. after reconnecting). Pass waitSeconds (up to 25) to have the server wait for new events or a status change before answering. Read-only.

afterSeq.description: Last event sequence number already received; return only later events.

conversationId.description: Conversation ID for filtering or continuing the associated agent work.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return in this page.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

runId.description: Run ID returned by preparation or execution for this project.

waitSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for new events or a job update; prefer long polling over repeated immediate requests. Optional long poll: wait up to this many seconds (0–25, default 0) on the server for a change before returning.

name: playground_run_events

next.description: Suggested next action; it does not authorize spending.
